shortDescription: Manage SMB shares on PowerScale Storage System

options.name: access_based_enumeration
options.description: Only enumerates files and folders for the requesting user has access to.

options.name: access_based_enumeration_root_only
options.description: Access-based enumeration on only the root directory of the share.

options.name: access_zone
options.description: Access zone which contains this share. If not specified it will be considered as a System Access Zone. For a non-System Access Zone the effective path where the SMB is created will be determined by the base path of the Access Zone and the path provided by the user in the playbook. For a System Access Zone the effective path will be the absolute path provided by the user in the playbook.

options.name: allow_delete_readonly
options.description: Allow deletion of read-only files in the share.

options.name: allow_execute_always
options.description: Allow users to execute files they have rigths for.

options.name: allow_variable_expansion
options.description: Allow automatic expansion of variables for home directories.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: api_user
options.description: username of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: auto_create_directory
options.description: Automatically create home directories.

options.name: browsable
options.description: Share is visible in net view and the browse list.

options.name: ca_timeout
options.description: Continuosly available timeout for the SMB share.

options.name: ca_write_integrity
options.description: Specify the level of write-integrity on continuously available shares.

options.name: change_notify
options.description: Level of change notification alerts on the share.

options.name: continuously_available
options.description: Specify if persistent opens are allowed on the share.

options.name: create_path
options.description: Create path if does not exist.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the SMB share.

options.name: directory_create_mask
options.description: Directory creates mask bits. Octal value for owner, group, and others against read, write, and execute.

options.name: directory_create_mode
options.description: Directory creates mode bits. Octal value for owner, group, and others against read, write, and execute.

options.name: file_create_mask
options.description: File creates mask bits. Octal value for owner, group, and others against read, write, and execute.

options.name: file_create_mode
options.description: File creates mode bits. Octal value for owner, group, and others against read, write, and execute.

options.name: file_filter_extension
options.description: Details of file filter extensions.

options.name: file_filtering_enabled
options.description: Enables file filtering on this zone.

options.name: host_acls
options.description: An ACL expressing which hosts are allowed access. A deny clause must be the final entry.

options.name: impersonate_guest
options.description: Specify the condition in which user access is done as the guest account.

options.name: impersonate_user
options.description: User account to be used as guest account.

options.name: inheritable_path_acl
options.description: Set inheritable acl on share path.

options.name: new_share_name
options.description: The new name of the SMB share.

options.name: ntfs_acl_support
options.description: Support NTFS ACLs on files and directories.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: oplocks
options.description: Support oplocks.

options.name: path
options.description: The path of the SMB share. This parameter will be mandatory only for the create operation. This is the absolute path for System Access Zone and the relative path for non-System Access Zone.

options.name: permissions
options.description: Specifies permission for specific user, group, or trustee. Valid options read, write, and full. This is a list of dictionaries. Each dictionry entry has 3 mandatory values as listed below. 1)I(user_name)/I(group_name)/I(wellknown) can have actual name of the trustee like C(user)/C(group)/C(wellknown). 2)I(permission) can be C(read)/'C(write)/C(full). 3)I(permission_type) can be C(allow)/C(deny). options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: run_as_root
options.description: Allow account to run as root.

options.name: share_name
options.description: The name of the SMB share.

options.name: smb3_encryption_enabled
options.description: Enables SMB3 encryption for the share.

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the SMB share should exist or not.

options.name: strict_ca_lockout
options.description: Specifies if persistent opens would do strict lockout on the share.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
